name: pixifact-workspace
description: Pixifact framework、Editor 和 CLI 的 workspace。
author: youxia <243802688@qq.com>

scripts.build: cd packages/pixifact && bun run build && cd ../platform-wechat && bun run build && cd ../platform-douyin && bun run build && cd ../three && bun run build
scripts.editor: bun run editor:frontend:build && bun run pixifact -- editor
scripts.release:check: bun run test && bun run editor:typecheck && bun run build && bun run editor:frontend:build && cd packages/create-pixifact && bun run build && cd ../.. && bun scripts/check-release-packages.mjs && bun scripts/check-release-install.mjs
scripts.release:version: changeset version && bun scripts/sync-template-versions.mjs && bun install --lockfile-only
